newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud underwrites Polish Poligrafia issue.
newsitem.headline: Exbud underwrites Polish Poligrafia issue.

text.p: Polish construction company Exbud SA and Penetrator brokerage underwrote the 1,357,280 shares of of Polish printing house Poligrafia SA initial public offering, Poligrafia's president said.

Helena Zych told a news conference Exbud, which currently has a 88.76 percent stake in Poligrafia, underwrote 1,085,824 shares and Penetrator, which is offering the issue, 271,456 shares of the November offering.
"Exbud and Penetrator underwrite the new issue," she said.
She added the stand-by fee was 2.8 percent.
Zych also said the company, which seeks parallel market's listing, expected its market share to rise to 10 percent from two percent in 1995.
"In 1995 we had two percent but we hope to achieve 10 percent," she said, but did not give any details.
The company earlier set the issue price at 7.5 zlotys.

Exbud financial director Leszek Walczyk, also present, said the company, which would have its stake in Poligrafia diluted to 55 percent after the issue, did not so far have an intention to sell its shares in Poligrafia.
The shares will be offered ex-rights with the large-investors' 857,280-share tranche between November 12-15 and the 500,000-share small investor tranche between November 4-8.
The firm earlier said it expected its net profit to rise to two million zlotys this year and to 2.8 million zlotys in 1997, up from last year's net of 0.8 million zlotys.
